g.text: Colemak-DH · Bilateral Home-Row Mods · Semantic F13–F24 Protocol · 42 Positions · 6-Thumb Layer Model
RH2 falls through to BASE Del/FUN. Not an exit.
Left side: NAV LT5 / ADJUST LT5
Right side: NUM RT5 / ADJUST RT5
Right BOOT requires split link. Use
HOST and edit semantic signals require
the active macOS or Windows host bridge.
